authorship: Source/math oracle and receiving adapter have the same author; candidate execution is separately recorded.

environment.scalar_target_assumption: IEEE754 binary64; default nearest ties-even; gradual underflow; no fast-math/reassociation/FMA contraction across source steps. Target runtime qualification remains later receiving work.
environment.context_basis: Explicit fixture configuration, not observation of a historical mutable Python process.
environment.limits_basis: Active bounded receiving configuration, not original Python acceptance limits. Core converter inputs are already constructed values; input loading is not the lexical API under test.
environment.builtin_sum_source_branch: Pinned CPython 3.13.11 ordinary #ifndef SLOW_SUM branch. Historical build flags are not newly observed.

cases.title: Measurement totals, means, subtype and arbitrary integer carrier
cases.derivation: Real grouped numeric summaries. SUM keeps first dtype until a later promotion; AVG integer domain divides Decimal exactly in these examples.

runs.query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?part (SUM(?x) AS ?total) (AVG(?x) AS ?mean) (COUNT(?x) AS ?n) (SAMPLE(?x) AS ?sample) WHERE { VALUES (?part ?x) { (1 2) (1 4) (2 8) } } GROUP BY ?part

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?s) (AVG(?x) AS ?a) WHERE { VALUES ?x { "3"^^xsd:int } }

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?s) (AVG(?x) AS ?a) WHERE { VALUES ?x { "3"^^xsd:int "3"^^xsd:int } }

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?s) (AVG(?x) AS ?a) WHERE { VALUES ?x { 9223372036854775808 1 } }

cases.title: Aggregate output survives aliases and downstream numeric consumers
cases.derivation: Every result is constructed by actual aggregate finish, then reused through a subquery variable. No second interpreter or replacement AST is permitted.

runs.query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?total ?mean ?score WHERE { { SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?total) (AVG(?x) AS ?mean) WHERE { VALUES ?x { 2 4 } } } BIND(?total + ?mean AS ?score) FILTER(?score) }

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SAMPLE(?score) AS ?selected) (COUNT(?score) AS ?n) WHERE { { SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?total) (AVG(?x) AS ?mean) WHERE { VALUES ?x { 2 4 } } } BIND(?total + ?mean AS ?score) FILTER(?score) }

cases.title: Empty group and prior COUNT/SAMPLE presence controls
cases.derivation: FrozenBindings presence is the boundary. Pending SAMPLE inserts None; alias Extend carries it. Explicit empty Group has no accumulator, hence hidden aliases remain absent. This agrees with the previous EXPRESSION-AGGREGATE empty_cases; scope01 SA03 prose had incorrectly collapsed presence to the later wrapper.

runs.query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?s) (AVG(?x) AS ?a) (COUNT(*) AS ?c) (SAMPLE(?x) AS ?v) WHERE { VALUES ?x {} }

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT ?g (COUNT(*) AS ?c) (SAMPLE(?x) AS ?v) WHERE { VALUES (?g ?x) {} } GROUP BY ?g

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?missing) AS ?s) (AVG(?missing) AS ?a) (COUNT(?missing) AS ?c) (COUNT(*) AS ?rows) (SAMPLE(?missing) AS ?v) WHERE {}

cases.derivation: Inherited use_row raises bare missing before update, unlike Counter override. A compound expression can instead return a fresh error object, leading to numeric/type handling inside the consumer.

runs.query:

cases.title: Bad measurement skip differs between SUM and AVG
cases.derivation: SUM accesses datatype before numeric, AVG calls numeric first. An existing explicit None is a returned value, distinct from absent binding.

cases.title: RDF DISTINCT with retained per-instance numeric cache
cases.derivation: Same RDF may carry distinct actual Python-family caches. DISTINCT selects first RDF identity; the numeric helper must consume that accepted cell rather than a global RDF cache.

runs.query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(DISTINCT ?x) AS ?s) (AVG(DISTINCT ?x) AS ?a) (COUNT(DISTINCT ?x) AS ?d) (COUNT(?x) AS ?all) WHERE { { BIND(?left AS ?x) } UNION { BIND(?right AS ?x) } }

cases.title: Stepwise Decimal sum, scale, zero and average division
cases.derivation: Every row restarts Python sum over (acc,incoming) from int0. Decimal addition/average division separately round under the shared context; construction is exact.

runs.query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?s) (AVG(?x) AS ?a) WHERE { VALUES ?x { "1.0000000000000000000000000005"^^xsd:decimal } }
runs.math_derivation: coefficient=10^28+5 at exponent -28; p28 shift1 tie to even coefficient10^27, exponent-27; /1 preserves preferred exponent

runs.query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?s) (AVG(?x) AS ?a) WHERE { VALUES ?x { 1.2345 0.005 } }
runs.math_derivation: row1 0+1.2345 rounds1.23; row2 0+1.23 exact then+0.005=1.235 halfway with odd123 rounds1.24; divide2 exact0.62

runs.query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?s) (AVG(?x) AS ?a) WHERE { VALUES ?x { "-0.0"^^xsd:decimal "-0.0"^^xsd:decimal } }
runs.math_derivation: HalfEven zero-start additions with opposite zero signs produce positive zero at preferred exponent-1; /positive2 retains it

runs.query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?s) (AVG(?x) AS ?a) WHERE { VALUES ?x { 1 0 0 } }
runs.math_derivation: integer row sums exact; Decimal1/Decimal3 p28 repeats3 and rounds down

cases.title: Per-row float sum is not whole-group compensated sum
cases.derivation: Compensation is local to each two-element builtin sum call. Decimal/float conversion is lazy in accumulator/input order; this is not Python math.fsum over the whole group.

runs.query:
PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?s) (AVG(?x) AS ?a) WHERE { VALUES ?x { -0e0 -0e0 } }

PREFIX xsd: <http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema#>
SELECT (SUM(?x) AS ?s) (AVG(?x) AS ?a) WHERE { VALUES ?x { 1e16 1e0 -1e16 } }
runs.math_derivation: per-row total states 1e16,1e16,0; one is lost at the second row and compensation is not retained into the third

cases.title: Raw Group keys, AS alias and first-seen lazy finish
cases.derivation: Raw returned errors are identity keys, while AS evaluates through Extend and then variable lookup. Projected bare variables are implicit SAMPLE. Update failures precede every group output; finish failures preserve the already-yielded prefix, and LIMIT does not finalize later groups.
